title: 1996 AMC 8 Problem 25
statement: A point is chosen at random from within a circular region. What is the probability that the point is closer to the center of the region than it is to the boundary of the region?

solutions.text:
Take the radius to be \(1.\) A point at distance \(r\) from the center is closer to the center than to the boundary when \(r \lt 1 - r,\) i.e. \(r \lt \tfrac12.\)

The favorable region is a circle of radius \(\tfrac12,\) with area \(\pi(\tfrac12)^2 = \tfrac{\pi}{4},\) out of the total area \(\pi.\) The probability is \(\dfrac{\frac{\pi}{4}}{\pi} = \dfrac14.\)

Thus, the correct answer is A .
hints: A point is closer to the center than the boundary exactly when its distance from the center is less than half the radius
Compare the area of the inner circle of radius \(\tfrac12\) to the whole circle of radius \(1\)
